description: SCSS mixins for hover effects in Bootstrap, with deprecated hover media query support.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on `:hover` pseudo-class.

methods.name: hover-focus
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on `:hover` and `:focus` pseudo-classes.

methods.name: plain-hover-focus
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on the element itself, `:hover`, and `:focus`.

methods.name: hover-focus-active
methods.description: A Sass mixin that applies styles on `:hover`, `:focus`, and `:active` pseudo-classes.
